plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of strange events, talks about a building there called Homestead 3. He says it is the oldest structure on the property and that some people who visit refuse to go inside it. He tells it as one of the places on the ranch where people feel something is wrong.
